full_prompt_en: The image is a square studio photograph-like rendering of a handcrafted builder figure on a warm tan ground and matching plain background. The backdrop curves into the floor without a visible horizon, creating a simple enclosed studio space with a slight tonal gradient. In the centre, a stocky toy man stands facing forward, his oversized head and broad boots giving him a compact, sturdy silhouette. A yellow construction helmet sits high on his head, with raised vertical ridges and small worn-looking scuffs along its surface. Beneath it, his light peach face has tiny dark eyes, a long rounded nose and a thick brown moustache that extends across the lower face. His ears project on either side, while the rest of the facial features remain simplified and gently asymmetrical. A muted rust-red knitted sweater covers his arms and chest, with coarse loops and soft fuzzy edges visible along the sleeves. Over it, blue-green work overalls have a thick, slightly rough fabric texture, broad straps and a rectangular chest panel. Across that panel, bold cream lettering reads "BOB", standing clearly against the dark teal cloth. Around the waist, a tan leather-like belt closes with a broad rectangular metal buckle, and small pouches hang to either side. Narrow hand tools with yellow and red handles rise from the belt, their shapes simplified but visibly distinct from the fabric. His arms hang close to the body, ending in oversized beige work gloves with rounded fingers and stitched-looking seams. At the lower left, one glove holds the handle of a rectangular orange-brown toolbox, which rests near the ground beside his boot. The front of the box carries the cream word "BOB", along with dark framing strips, small latches and rubbed patches around the corners. Behind the left shoulder, a rolled grey item and narrow equipment pieces suggest a packed working kit, partly hidden by the figure. The blue-green trouser legs end above thick brown boots, whose wide soles sit firmly on the textured floor. The lighting is soft and warm from the upper left, revealing woolly fabric, worn metal and painted surfaces while casting a low shadow behind and to the right. The overall composition is centred and stable, combining friendly toy proportions, tactile handmade materials and a restrained ochre-teal palette against an uncluttered studio ground.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形棚拍感渲染，手工建筑工人玩偶站在暖黄褐地面上，背景是同色朴素色面。背景与地面平滑连接，没有明确地平线，轻微明暗渐变形成简单摄影棚空间。中央敦实玩偶男子正面站立，大头和宽靴使轮廓紧凑稳健。黄色安全帽戴在头顶，有隆起竖筋和小块旧化擦痕。帽下浅桃色脸有细小深眼睛、长而圆的鼻子和横跨下半脸的浓棕色八字胡。双耳向两边突出，其他面部特征简化且略不对称。灰锈红针织衫覆盖手臂和胸部，袖子可见粗线圈和柔软绒边。外穿蓝绿色工装背带裤，布料厚而略粗，宽背带连接矩形胸兜。胸兜上粗体乳白字母写着“BOB”，在暗青绿布面上很清楚。腰间黄褐皮革感腰带以宽矩形金属扣闭合，两侧挂着小工具袋。黄柄与红柄细工具从腰带处伸出，形状简化，但与布料清楚区分。双臂贴近身体下垂，末端是大号米色劳动手套，指头圆钝，接缝像缝制而成。左下方一只手套握着矩形橙棕工具箱提手，箱子在靴旁接近地面。箱体正面也有乳白“BOB”，同时可见深边框、小锁扣和角部磨擦色斑。左肩后方露出灰色卷状物和细长装备，像背着工作包，被人物部分遮挡。蓝绿裤腿止于厚棕靴上方，宽鞋底稳稳落在有颗粒质感的地面。柔和暖光从左上照来，显现毛织布、旧金属和涂装表面，低矮阴影落向后右方。整体构图居中稳定，将亲切玩偶比例、可触手工材料和克制赭黄青绿配色置于简洁棚拍背景中。
style_prompt_en: The rendering emphasises handmade miniature material rather than seamless plastic polish. Rounded, slightly uneven forms combine knitted loops, rough woven surfaces, soft felt-like edges, worn leather tones and scuffed painted areas. Muted teal and rust are balanced by warm ochre and cream, with small darker accents defining seams and recesses. Soft upper-side studio light reveals texture at a close scale and produces short grounding shadows. A plain colour field isolates the compact silhouette and preserves generous surrounding space. The overall design is friendly, weighty and tactile, with simplified proportions, restrained wear and clear separation between distinct materials.
style_prompt_zh: 渲染强调手工微缩材料，而非无缝塑料抛光。圆润、略不规整的形态融合针织线圈、粗织表面、柔毡毛边、旧皮革色与磨损涂装。低饱和青绿、锈红与暖赭、乳白平衡，少量深色强调接缝和凹处。上侧柔棚光在近距离显现纹理，并产生短小落地阴影。单色背景隔离紧凑轮廓，保留适当周围空间。整体亲切、扎实且可触，以简化比例、克制磨损和不同材料间清楚的区别形成风格。
theme_en: Handcrafted builder figure with a toolbox
theme_zh: 手提工具箱的手工质感建筑工人玩偶
name: Bob the Builder
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
